text:
rita: Quick question 19145 running the Python quickstart and the client stalls on initial request. Browser shows WS connect then an auth 401 then a subsequent 403. Logs say 'no cached token; refresh rejected'. Using a workspace invite (SSO) account. Anyone seen this? :frowning:

devex-bot: Ticket created DEVEX-5299. Please paste minimal logs and whether you used SSO/invite or created a personal key.

rita: Paste of the flask quickstart console:
```
INFO:uvicorn:Started server at http://127.0.0.1:8000
[2026-03-22T20:10:01Z] auth: lookup cached token -> none
[2026-03-22T20:10:01Z] auth: attempting refresh -> POST /auth/refresh
[2026-03-22T20:10:01Z] http: 401 Unauthorized
[2026-03-22T20:10:02Z] http: 403 Forbidden from auth/refresh
Exception: refresh rejected: 403
  File "/app/env/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/sdk/auth.py", line 98, in refresh_token
    raise AuthError('refresh rejected', code=403)
```

toni: That pattern (401 then 403 on refresh) usually means the initial service key is scoped to the workspace but the org hasn't completed billing/terms, or an admin needs to accept invites. SSO invites often have that extra gating step.

ben: Short-term workaround: generate a personal API key from your profile (Profile -> API keys) and export REDWOOD_API_KEY locally in the quickstart env. Personal keys bypass the org-level first-call gate for local dev.

carla: Another dev-friendly option is `npx @redwood/cli login` (works cross-language). It performs an interactive browser auth and writes a dev token to ~/.redwood/token which the SDKs prefer over empty caches. Mount that into containers or set it in your env for the quickstart.

rita: CLI login worked. Quickstart now returns 200 and the websocket streams. Thanks!

toni: Filing a follow-up in DEVEX-5299: add an explicit quickstart troubleshooting section for SSO/invite users and recommend two paths (personal key or CLI login). Also propose SDK change: when refresh returns 403 and no cached token, return a typed error like `ERR_ONBOARD_BILLING` and include a user-facing hint URL.

ben: Agree. I'll open a tiny PR to the python quickstart that catches AuthError on refresh and prints a helpful hint: "Your org may require billing/terms acceptance for invited/SSO users. Visit https://console.redwood.ai/orgs or use a personal API key for local dev."

carla: Also suggest we improve onboarding emails to call out the billing acceptance step for SSO invites so new users don't run into this blind spot.

rita: Attaching the repro to DEVEX-5299. Happy to review the quickstart PR once it's up.
